risk_if_not_implemented: Without Technology Assets, Applications, Services and Data (TAASD) Portability, Technology Assets, Applications, Services and Data (TAASD) may be trapped with the outgoing provider, or transferred in a way that breaches confidentiality, corrupts integrity or interrupts availability. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Uncontrolled Third-Party Security / Privacy Exposure (R-GV-5), Third-Party Dependency Failure (R-SC-6), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), Loss of Data Integrity (R-IP-3), Loss of Data / Service Availability (R-IP-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Supplier Financial Distress / Insolvency (MT-24).

compensating_control_1.name: External Transfer of Sensitive / Regulated Data
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to restrict and govern the transfer of sensitive and/or regulated data:
(1) Cross-border; and/or
(2) Interorganizational.
compensating_control_1.justification: External Transfer of Sensitive / Regulated Data (DCH-32) compensates for the absence of Technology Assets, Applications, Services and Data (TAASD) Portability (TPM-24.2) by governing how sensitive and/or regulated data is transferred to external parties, which protects confidentiality and integrity during any migration that does occur. Given the data-handling nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Data Backups
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to create recurring backups of data, software and/or system images, as well as verify the integrity of these backups, to ensure the availability of the data to satisfy Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).
compensating_control_2.justification: Data Backups (BCD-24) compensates for the absence of Technology Assets, Applications, Services and Data (TAASD) Portability (TPM-24.2) by maintaining organization-controlled backups of data, software and system images, which ensures the organization retains an independent, restorable copy regardless of the provider's cooperation. Given the data-handling nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
